caseNameFull: ERNEST KREHER, MAX KREHER, PAUL KREHER, TRUSTEES OF TAMPA SHIPBUILDING & ENGINEERING COMPANY, A DISSOLVED CORPORATION v. United States

opinions.text:
Eminent domain; just compensation; suit by trustees of dissolved corporation. Petition dismissed.

Plaintiffs’ petition, for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court October 9, 1950.
